prompt.project_info: Create a vibrant cozy top-down portrait of an approved adult red-haired woman lying on a colorful knitted surface.
prompt.main_subject: An approved adult woman with long vibrant ginger-red hair, messy bangs and loose waves spread in a halo, pale skin with natural freckles across nose and cheeks, blue-grey eyes with soft winged liner, matte rose lips, delicate gold chain and multiple small silver ear hoops/studs. She wears a chunky color-block patchwork sweater in red, mustard yellow, charcoal grey, and deep plum with visible ribbed and cable-knit texture.
prompt.composition_elements: Top-down flat-lay close-up, face centered and hair spread around the head, rainbow knitted surface with horizontal blue, lavender, and bubblegum-pink stripes, sweater panels clearly visible at the lower frame.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft even natural light with no harsh shadows, highlighting freckles, hair shine, knit texture, and vibrant cozy color. Keep the dreamy calm direct gaze.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic 4K portrait, top-down close-up, crystal-clear face and knit detail, accurate hair strands, natural skin texture, vivid but balanced color, subtle grain, no watermark.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a photorealistic 4K top-down close-up portrait of an approved adult woman with vibrant messy ginger-red hair spread in a halo around her head, pale skin with natural freckles across her nose and cheeks, blue-grey eyes with soft black winged liner, matte rose lips, a delicate gold chain, and multiple small silver ear hoops and studs. She wears a cozy chunky patchwork sweater with red, mustard yellow, charcoal grey, and deep plum panels, visible ribbed and cable-knit textures, and a dark grey crew neckline. She lies on a colorful knitted surface with horizontal blue, lavender, and bubblegum-pink stripes. Keep her calm direct gaze, soft even natural light, vivid balanced colors, realistic hair and knit texture, and crystal-clear 4K detail.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexualized framing, minor or child, age ambiguity, celebrity likeness, public-figure likeness, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, extra fingers, deformed hands, distorted face, melted knit texture, text, logo
